t: What 'Buying the Dip' Really Means (And When It Becomes a Falling Knife)
s: July 16, 2025 - Buying the dip is a fairly straightforward approach. During a bull market, when the optimism for the outlook of stocks is high, traders can still find individual stocks whose prices have recently experienced a significant decline. If a stock has promising fundamentals, traders can buy at the depressed price point with the expectation that the stock will rebound enough to generate a profit.
